en.t: Then you should go back early too."
So he urged the attendant to return.

units.source_text: 匂亲王容姿俊俏，风度优美，深夜露湿了衣裳，衣香随风四散，美妙不可言喻。

en.t: Prince Niou was handsome in appearance and graceful in bearing; the late-night dew had dampened his robes, and their fragrance scattered on the wind, beautiful beyond words.

units.source_text: 侍从吞声饮泣地回山庄去了。

en.t: The attendant went back to the mountain villa, sobbing with stifled cries.
